name: Under the Indigo Sky: The First Step
source:
Mason Cornette (but let's call him "MC") has been attending "Student Karaoke Night" at The Fifth Tape for weeks hoping to make some connections with new people, but was always too shy to approach anyone. That is, until he's given a friendly nudge...

[From [url=https://indiskye.itch.io/1st-step]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅森·科内特（Mason Cornette，我们暂且称他为“MC”）几周来一直参加第五磁带的“学生卡拉OK之夜”，希望与新朋友建立联系，但总是害羞而不敢接近任何人。也就是说，直到他友好地推了一下……

[来自[url=https://indiskye.itch.io/1st-step]Itch.io[/url]]
